title: Create: Dream Modpack
description:

body:
## About the Modpack

This modpack is mainly focused on the **Create** mod and several additional mods that expand automation, machines, and technical gameplay in Minecraft.

The goal of this modpack is to make the Create experience more interesting by adding useful quality-of-life mods and small gameplay improvements while keeping the main focus on building machines and automation.

⚠️ **Beta Notice**
This modpack is currently in **Beta**, so bugs or balance issues may occur. Future updates may change mods, configs, and gameplay.

## Features

* Create-focused gameplay
* Automation and mechanical systems
* Quality-of-life improvements
* A lightweight modpack that is easy to run

## Disclaimer

I did **not create any of the mods included in this modpack**.

This project only combines existing mods into a modpack for easier installation.
